lines.zh: 我绕着黄花打转，停不下。
lines.en: I circle the yellow blooms and can't stop.

lines.zh: 花海上，我的影子是一片黄。
lines.en: Over the flower field, my shadow is a patch of yellow.
The swamp water is singing.
I ride the wind toward the flower field.
A single petal carries me along.

lines.zh: 花丛间的路，我闭眼都熟。
lines.en: I know the path through these flowers blindfolded.
My yellow wings spin among the flowers.
My antennae measure the wind first.
Birch water — a touch colder.
Birch leaves are slick — I missed my step.
My wing membrane beats smoother today.
Flower field wind spins me around.
That yellow over the birches is me.
I land on a grass tip and bounce off.
Slow wingbeats — save my strength.
Who moved my flower?

lines.zh: 我的黄翅，在桦木间最显眼。
lines.en: Yellow wings stand out among birch.

lines.zh: 一只蜜蜂抢了我的位子。
lines.en: A bee stole my spot.
Yellow wings stand out over the flowers.
The petal is soft as a bed.
I follow the light through the birches.
Summer is short — don't hurry me.
The dew is heavy — I lie still.
Sun on my yellow wings warms them to the root.
I rest a while. Only a while.

lines.zh: 潮水推过来，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: The tide comes in, and I don't budge.
I bathed in a flower's cup.
I count the black rims on my wings.
I've counted how deep the sea goes.
A birch shadow shades me just right.
You're so big, and I'm so light.
Yellow wings spread like petals.
Hold still, and I dare come closer.

lines.zh: 黄瓜花上，我停了一整个下午。
lines.en: I sat on a cucumber flower all afternoon.
Don't reach out — my wing dust will rub off.
Don't let your shadow cover my flower.
Yellow Swallowtail Butterfly? I'll remember that.

lines.zh: 黄翅一进水里，就成金色。
lines.en: Yellow wings turn gold underwater.
Are you here for nectar too?

lines.zh: 黄翅一闪，我就在你眼前。
lines.en: One flash of yellow, and I am before you.
Rust floats on the water.
My wings are wet; I cannot fly.
My wing remembers that blow.
Pollen sticks to my wings; they feel heavier.
A twinge at my wing root — I can't fly.
Who swatted me? My dust is gone.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被水汽压得抬不起来。
lines.en: The damp weighs my wings down.
That one bent my wing.
It hurts; two circles to steady myself.
My wings are thin as paper.
It smells sweet, so I come down.
That scent tugs at me till I fret.
Are you hiding nectar in that hand?
Leave me one flower, just one.
I circle the flower’s heart and won’t leave.
My wingbeats slow — I only think of food.
I've landed on your shoulder — don't move.
One yellow sweep and the meadow lights up.

lines.zh: 黄翅一扇，花粉全扬起来。
lines.en: One beat of my yellow wings and pollen rises.
That bloom — the sweetness drifts over.
I ride the birch wood's breeze.
I touched you — moving aside.
A layer of wing dust came off.
Who laid a branch across the flower?
One wing corner bent.
Drifting along, I bumped right into it.
Light as I am, the bump hurts.

lines.zh: 水被你撞散，又慢慢合上。
lines.en: The water you broke slowly closes again.
One of my wings is knocked askew.
I'm light, but bumps still hurt.
The eggs go under this leaf.

lines.zh: 你的颜色像晚霞，也像花海。
lines.en: Your colors are sunset, and flower field.
We rest wing to wing on the bloom.
The rhythm of your wings is lovely.
Yellow wings drift slowly over flowers.
Everyone chases these yellow wings.
One touch of yellow wings seals it.
Circle me — don't stop.

lines.zh: 你翅膀的颜色，分我一点。
lines.en: Let your wing colour rub off on mine.

lines.zh: 这朵黄花的颜色，跟我一样。
lines.en: This yellow flower is the same shade as me.

lines.zh: 我翅上的黄，桦树皮一样。
lines.en: The yellow on my wings matches birch bark.
I drag this petal along.
Perfect padding for the nest.

lines.zh: 凤尾上沾的粉，也别浪费。
lines.en: Even the dust on my swallowtail is worth keeping.
What sticks to my yellow wings is mine.
A small thing, yet my wings dip.
Someone dropped it — mine now.
Pollen all over me — worth it.
I can carry it, though I wobble.
A bright seed on the ground.
A little nectar lasts me half a day.
I saw that white bloom first.
Over there — right now.
That's mine — don't grab it.

lines.zh: 桦木林的黄花，我最先看见。
lines.en: I see the birch-wood yellow bloom first.

lines.zh: 石头后面那口气，我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that breath behind the stone.
Wings tucked — I'm going in.
That bug shadow ahead is mine.
Locked on — I won't look away.

lines.zh: 黄色的翅，在花海上很显眼。
lines.en: Yellow wings stand out over the flower field.
The flower's ahead — don't wilt on me.
You can't fly fast; I'll follow.
I slip quietly closer.
Wings this loud — and still hiding?

lines.zh: 桦木林的花，我还没数完。
lines.en: I have not finished counting the birch flowers.
The flower field's wind pushes you closer.

lines.zh: 我停在桦叶上，翅还开着。
lines.en: On a birch leaf, wings still open.
Don't hide under the leaf.
Around this bush, then I cut in.
The wind helps me; you can't escape.
Hurt? Fly off — I won't chase.
I fly fast. You cannot catch me.
One bump from me — now go.
My mouthparts are harder than you think.
Don't take my flower!
My wingbeat can sting too.
Remember this bump.
The flowers are my ground.
One more hit — back off.
I strike with my wing edge.
I know this mud.
I've landed at the edge of the flower field.
The first gust of wind is so cool.
My legs are weak — I'll stand a while.
This birch wood smells so sweet.
Who called me? Nobody.
My wings are still soft — don't touch.
I circle above the flower field.
The shell split — I dry my wings first.
I've crawled out of the chrysalis.
Birch wood wings curl at a spark.
Even drifting, a fall still hurts.
Wings soaked through — I'm sinking.

lines.zh: 炸开的水花，溅了我一身。
lines.en: The blast threw water all over me.

lines.zh: 我的尾翅被扎穿，飞不稳了。
lines.en: My tail wing is pierced; my flight falters.
Violet light swept past; my wings go numb.
The blooms are over; I go hungry.
Lightning hit my wing; it still tingles.
No wind, no flowers — just falling.
